name: code-security-audit
description: A callable, offline Skill that scans inline source files for dangerous code patterns, insecure configuration, weak crypto, and license gaps using only the Python standard library. Applies a fixed set of heuristic regex rules line-by-line and returns findings (path+line+rule_id+severity+recommendation), a summary, and a block/review/pass verdict. Heuristic static checks, not a full SAST; human review required. No network, no API keys.

path.description: Logical file path (used for reporting and LICENSE detection).

content.description: Full file contents to scan line-by-line.

compliance_notes: These are heuristic static checks, not a full SAST; human review required. Findings are advisory and may include reasonable false positives.
This Skill runs fully offline: it makes no network calls and reads no API keys or credentials.
All source input is supplied inline (files[].path / files[].content); the Skill does not fetch, scrape, clone, or write files.
Output is deterministic: fixed rule set, stable sort order (severity, path, line), and no randomness or timestamps.
Errors are returned as a structured envelope with ok=false and an error.code; a Python traceback is never emitted.
